description:
Answer a modal dialog the VM raised (OK/Yes/No/Cancel/IntegerEntry/TextEntry).

Prerequisite: a dialog event must be present in perception.recent_events[] with kind=='dialog'. Read extras.dialog_id from that event.

Effect: unblocks the Sim's thread so the behavior that raised the dialog continues. For Restock Fridge the integer_value is the simoleon budget (e.g. 50); the fridge fills with food proportionally.

Cost: none — dialog responses are free in-world actions.

response_kind values:
  ok       — press the OK / Yes / single-button confirmation
  cancel   — press Cancel / No / dismiss
  integer  — enter a number (requires integer_value)
  string   — enter text (requires string_value)

args.name: dialog_id
args.description: The dialog_id from perception.recent_events[].extras.dialog_id (uint64 encoded as string).

args.name: response_kind
args.description: Which button or entry form to use. 'ok' = press OK/Yes. 'cancel' = press Cancel/No. 'integer' = numeric entry, pair with integer_value. 'string' = text entry, pair with string_value.

args.name: integer_value
args.description: Required when response_kind='integer'. The integer to enter — e.g. budget for Restock Fridge.

args.name: string_value
args.description: Required when response_kind='string'. The text to enter.

perception_hints: Pending dialog dialog_id: perception.recent_events[] where kind=='dialog', look at .extras.dialog_id
Dialog prompt text: perception.recent_events[].text (includes title prefix if present)
After responding: perception.recent_events[] should show interaction resuming (interaction_start/end events)
